record.title: Universal constant-compression exclusion for the fixed two-sided A4 family
record.statement: Over C, every rank-26 compression of the specified 46-dimensional space E=G+[G,G00]+G00 G G00 in Mat28 has image dimension at least 38. Equivalently, for all 26-dimensional U and two-dimensional W, the space of E matrices sending U into W has dimension at most 8. The prior low-rank reduction then gives dimension at least 104 for every constant rank-110 compression of the specified 112-dimensional conjugation limit, exceeding the necessary target maximum 103. Thus all constant long-map compressions of this fixed family are excluded, even with arbitrary Laurent first maps.
dependencies: AI-A4-TWOSIDED-RANKLOSS-001
AI-A4-TWOSIDED-LOWRANK-003
Literal source and unimodular normalization, with prior proof and certificate bytes pinned
Torus degeneration of Grassmannian flags, exact coverage of all 2,809 graded budget pairs, 24 rational minor identities, and a shared-flag argument
record.limitations: Only the one specified two-sided conjugation family with constant full-rank long-map compressions over C. Moving compressions, other singular paths and a full matrix target remain outside the theorem. The lower bound 38 is not claimed sharp. Same-session checks are not independent mathematical review. No formalization or exponent improvement.

record.title: Complete-grid cost gate for every fixed ordered part shape through 32 coordinates
record.origin: Owner-directed Codex extension of the credited aggregation setup
record.statement: For every conflict-free family of p complete ordered tripartitions with one fixed cardinality shape (a,b,c), d=a+b+c<=32, every complete-grid budget B>=product_r q_r strictly exceeds sum_t(product_r n_t,r)^(3/4), for all integer q_r>=2 and 1<=n_t,r<=q_r-1. An induced-edge count gives p<=min(C_U,C_V,C_W,floor(2E/(D_U+D_V+D_W-1))); coordinatewise weighted AM-GM and exact enumeration of all shapes certify the strict gap. The d=33 balanced row is a non-exclusion control. The centered corrected identity extends to these anisotropic rectangular targets over characteristic-zero fields.
dependencies: Solomonik and Blaeser arXiv:2610.26563v2 centered aggregation and asymptotic sum framework
AI-AGGREGATION-COST-FLOOR-003 induced-edge argument, extended to unequal fixed part sizes
Complete exact integer shape certificate and coordinatewise AM-GM
record.limitations: Limits the displayed complete-grid upper-bound budget, not actual tensor rank. Requires one fixed ordered part-size triple across products. Mixed graded shapes, pruned grids and new rank decompositions are outside this result. Dimension 33 is not a sufficient construction. No independent review or formalization.

record.title: Full centered target forces every fixed leading-grid coefficient
record.statement: Over characteristic zero, if one retained diagonal product fills every centered coordinate space of dimension q_r-1>=2, the product_r q_r main grid forms project to a linearly independent family on that product. Every nonempty standard correction projects to zero. Therefore an exact representation using those fixed forms forces every leading coefficient to be one; a Laurent degeneration forces each to be 1+O(lambda). The proof uses H_q pointwise-multiplied by H_q spanning K^q for q>=3 and tensor products of independent local row tensors.
dependencies: Credited centered aggregation forms and correction eligibility
Exact local spanning identity (e_i-e_j) times (e_i-e_k)=e_i for three distinct indices
record.limitations: Fixed forms only; does not exclude new linear forms, other decompositions, or pruning after all full targets are removed. The hypotheses q_r>=3 and a full target are essential, with exact small controls. No lower bound on actual tensor rank, independent review, formalization or exponent improvement.

record.title: Common-support cost floor after deleting zero aggregate forms
record.origin: Owner-directed Codex extension to smaller targets and mixed graded shapes
record.statement: For p independent matrix targets expressed as complete d-coordinate tripartitions, suppose the active coordinate pair of target dimension n_t,r has at least n_t,r+1 common nonzero row positions. A budget that retains nonzero main coefficients, deletes only identically zero rank-one forms, and then charges every surviving main and correction position satisfies B_prune>=(4/3^(3/4))^d*max_t(volume_t^(3/4)). Therefore p^4*3^(3d)<4^(4d) implies B_prune>sum_t(volume_t^(3/4)) for all positive integer dimensions and all support positions. Mixed ordered part sizes, product-dependent dimensions, and scalar gradings are allowed. Exact comparisons include the external 10/13/22 and local 29/106 families.
dependencies: Projection to the largest-volume independent target block
Coordinatewise weighted AM-GM
External asymptotic-sum framework credited to Solomonik and Blaeser arXiv:2610.26563v2
record.limitations: A position-budget limitation after zero-form pruning, not an actual tensor-rank lower bound. Requires the stated common-row-support size and nonzero main coefficients. Reweighting, cancellation among nonzero positions, other decompositions and separated centering rows are outside the result. Same-session audit only; no independent review, formalization or exponent improvement.

record.title: An explicit smaller-support border-rank budget for 22 unequal matrix products
record.origin: Owner-directed Codex restriction and exact count of a credited external graded family
record.statement: For every integer n>=2 over characteristic zero, the exported product-dependent dimension profile applied to the pinned general22 graded construction gives 22 independent matrix products, each of volume n^5, with border rank at most 4n^5+32n^4+102n^3+158n^2+118n+34. The main grid costs 4n(n+1)^4; every nonzero correction position is counted exactly. The difference from the classical rank upper bound 22n^5 has strictly positive coefficients 678,8570,7066,2266,328,18 after n=4+u, so the displayed border-rank cost is smaller for all n>=4. Ordered matrix shapes, profiles and exact all-n polynomials are exported.
dependencies: Solomonik and Blaeser arXiv:2610.26563v2 general22 tripartitions, signed grades and correction sets, with raw ancillary SHA256 enforced
Complete exact check of every external mixed triple, including nonpositive scalar grades
Centered dual maps on product-dependent smaller supports and complete nonzero-position count
AI-AGGREGATION-PRUNED-SUPPORT-006 for the direct 9/4 cost limitation
record.limitations: Border-rank upper bound and comparison with the stated classical rank upper bound only. No optimality, stable finite-precision runtime or improved exponent. The critical 9/4 mass is 22n^(15/4), and the common-support theorem excludes this displayed pruned budget for every allowed n. External family and mechanism retain credit. No historical priority, independent review or formalization.

source_record.title: Reduction of arbitrary constant compression to a 46-dimensional outer space
source_record.statement: Over C, the certified 112-dimensional limiting space L of the specified two-sided A4 conjugation has the stated exact four-by-four outer block form. Every element of ordinary rank at most four is confined to block (3,0), whose matrix space E=G+[G,G00]+G00 G G00 has dimension 46 in Mat28. The kernel of any constant rank-110 long-leg compression is therefore exactly a compression kernel of E. A full M(10,10,11) target requires a rank-26 pair Phat, Chat with dim(Phat E Chat)<=37, equivalently a 26-dimensional U and two-dimensional W with dim{E in E:E(U) subset W}>=9.
dependencies: AI-A4-TWOSIDED-RANKLOSS-001
AI-RESOLVENT-SHARP-MINRANK-001 Section 2: every nonzero matrix in G+G00 G has rank at least six
Credited minimum nonzero source rank sixteen
112 exact block-coordinate identities, 16 exact transpose-conjugation identities, and elementary two-sided projection rank inequality
source_record.limitations: Necessary reduction for the one specified fixed conjugation family with constant full-rank long-map compressions. This reduction alone is necessary; the later AI-A4-ARBITRARY-COMPRESSION-001 proves the universal lower bound 38 and excludes constant compressions in this family. It does not construct a full target. Same-session reasoning checks are not independent review. No formalization or exponent improvement.

source_record.title: Nine-direction rank-loss requirement for a full-source two-sided A4 conjugation
source_record.statement: Over C, conjugate the complete 112-dimensional normalized A4 slice space by I+t^-1 N, with the specified square-zero rank-sixteen source slice N=H_(0,0,0). Its complete saturated limit L acts by scalars on the stated twelve-dimensional subspace. For arbitrary constant full-rank maps P:C^112->C^110 and C:C^110->C^112, and an arbitrary Laurent first map, a degeneration to M(10,10,11) requires dim(P L C)<=103. Re-saturation recovers at most the number of lost leading directions, while the target has nonzero evaluation rank at least ten.
dependencies: Credited literal cyclic A4 source and unimodular source-unit normalization
Exact complete polynomial-combination certificate with 112 independent leading matrices and twelve scalar-action columns
Elementary saturated-lattice specialization, Grassmann dimension inequality and target evaluation rank
source_record.limitations: One specified two-sided conjugation family with constant long-leg compressions. The later AI-A4-ARBITRARY-COMPRESSION-001 excludes the necessary locus for constant compressions. Moving compressions, other source paths and other nilpotent factors remain outside the result. Exact coefficient replay and same-session proof checks are not independent mathematical review. No full target, formalization or exponent improvement.
